tools.name: nuclei_segment_stub
tools.description: Detect and outline individual nuclei in the slide (or a region), producing per-nucleus centroids, contours, and a cell class. Canned-output stub — swapped for CellViT++ behind the same contract at increment 7.

mpp.description: Target microns-per-pixel to run segmentation at.

tools.name: count_within_roi
tools.description: Deterministically count and compute the density of a given cell class within the region of interest, from already-segmented nuclei. The number is computed, never generated by the model (the grounded Claim lands at increment 6).

cell_class.description: Which cell class to count, e.g. lymphocyte or tumor.
